source_records.title: MCP specification overview
source_records.review_scope: Overview, protocol roles, per-request metadata model and optional extensions. No host compatibility or running bridge inferred.

source_records.title: MCP tools
source_records.review_scope: Tool definitions, input/output schemas, structured results, naming and state-handle guidance. Railway descriptors in this package are original proposed contracts, not copied implementation.

source_records.title: MCP resources
source_records.review_scope: Resource identity and retrieval model. Supports a distinction between compact tool results and separately retrieved detail; no server implementation demonstrated.

source_records.title: MCP transport overview
source_records.review_scope: Transport/version separation and compatibility notes. The reviewed revision differs from older connection-scoped handshake behaviour; actual host support remains a test.

source_records.title: MCP stdio transport
source_records.review_scope: Subprocess stdio framing, stderr/stdout separation, cancellation and version compatibility. Does not establish that a particular ChatGPT/Astra host launches local subprocesses.

source_records.title: MCP Streamable HTTP transport
source_records.review_scope: Version-specific transport, local binding, Origin checking and authentication requirements. No public endpoint, tunnel, transport or host connection is deployed here.

source_records.title: MCP security best practices
source_records.review_scope: Security context for local/proxied tools and trusted boundaries. The bridge design adds its own save-scoped authorisation; schema validation is not authentication.

source_records.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
source_records.review_scope: Official schema-draft index and specification reference. The delivered contract uses this schema dialect; semantic railway/permission validation remains separate.
